CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PRESSURE.title: Pressure
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PRESSURE.descrip: Each stack of [gold]Pressure[/gold] increases damage taken by 1%.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORY.title: Memory
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORY.descripti:
Increases cost by 1 each time it is played.
At the end of the turn, if in hand, [red]Forget[/red] it.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SWORD.title: Knight's Sword
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SWORD.descriptio: For each stack of [gold]Pressure[/gold] you gain, [gold]Knight's Sword[/gold] deals 1 additional damage.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORYSAKI.title: Sakiko's Memory
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_MEMORYSAKI.descr:
You can view Memory cards in the [blue]Memory Pile[/blue].
The [blue]Memory Pile[/blue] cannot record cards in the [red]Forgotten Pile[/red].
[b][blue]Often brings me pain, yet constantly inspires me to move forward.[/blue][/b]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SAKIFORGET.title: Forget
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_SAKIFORGET.descr:
Cards that are [red]Forgotten[/red] enter the [red]Forgotten Pile[/red].
Each time you [red]Forget[/red] a card, reduce [gold]Pressure[/gold] by 2.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_EGGS.title: Easter Egg
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_EGGS.description: Easter egg cards that are not focused on balance and are unrelated to the main mod.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NOCHEST.title: Twelve Pill Steel Plate Cost Reduction
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NOCHEST.descript: The cost reduction formula is 12/(2 × number of allies). After upgrade, it becomes 12/(number of allies).
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYPIANO.title: Piano Performance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYPIANO.descri: A special Attack belonging to Sakiko.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_OTHER_ANON.title: Alternate World Anon
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_OTHER_ANON.descr: [sine][pink]It doesn't seem like something I know, yet it feels familiar.[/pink][/sine]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_REMEMBER_CHORD.d:
Right-click the relic to open the [pink]Chord Collection[/pink].
[b][pink]Uwaa... I haven't practiced for so long, I almost forgot.[/pink][/b]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYGUITAR.title: Guitar Performance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_PLAYGUITAR.descr: A special Attack belonging to Anon.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.title: Chord
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.descriptio:
The first time you play it, gain/replace a [gold]Chord[/gold].
Playing it again will store a corresponding [gold]Chord[/gold].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NO_NOTE.title: Special Performance
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_KEYWORD_NO_NOTE.descript: Playing this card does not grant [pink]Notes[/pink].
